title: ChatCompletionMessage
description: A message in the conversation. Supports roles: `system`, `user`, `assistant`, and `tool`.

role.description: The role of the message author: `system` (instructions), `user` (input), `assistant` (model response), or `tool` (tool result).

content.description: The message content. Can be a string or an array of content parts (text, image, audio) for multimodal inputs.

name.description: An optional name for the participant. Useful for distinguishing between multiple users or assistants.

tool_calls.description: Tool calls generated by the model (for assistant messages).

tool_call_id.description: The ID of the tool call this message responds to (required for tool messages).
